member.name: T:DotnetClaw.Jobby.CronService
member.summary:
Background service that drives the job scheduler.
Design: • Polls the every (30 s) • For each enabled job whose NextRunAt ≤ UTC now it: 1. Calls with the job prompt 2. Records LastRunAt and a trimmed LastResult 3. For recurring jobs: advances NextRunAt using the CRON expression 4. For one-shot jobs: disables the job so it never fires again • Jobs are executed sequentially per tick (fire-and-forget across ticks)

member.name: T:DotnetClaw.Jobby.JobbyPlugin
member.summary:
Semantic Kernel plugin that lets the agent manage background jobs.
The agent can call these functions in response to natural-language requests like: "send me a summary of my calendar every morning at 8:00" → schedule_job(name, "summarise my calendar", "0 8 * * *")
Natural language schedules are converted to CRON expressions by the LLM before passing them to .
